mapper.select: SELECT CASE WHEN cm.sender_id = #{userId} THEN cm.receiver_id ELSE cm.sender_id END AS otherUserId, u.nickname AS otherUserName, u.avatar AS otherUserAvatar, cm.goods_id AS goodsId, g.title AS goodsTitle, SUBSTRING_INDEX(g.images, ',', 1) AS goodsImage, g.price AS goodsPrice, CASE WHEN cm.content IS NOT NULL AND cm.content != '' THEN cm.content ELSE '[图片]' END AS lastMessage, cm.image_url AS lastMessageImageUrl, cm.create_time AS lastMessageTime, COALESCE(un.unread_count, 0) AS unreadCount FROM chat_message cm INNER JOIN ( -- 每个会话的最新消息时间（按用户对 + 商品分组） SELECT LEAST(sender_id, receiver_id) AS user_a, GREATEST(sender_id, receiver_id) AS user_b, goods_id, MAX(create_time) AS max_time FROM chat_message WHERE #{userId} IN (sender_id, receiver_id) GROUP BY LEAST(sender_id, receiver_id), GREATEST(sender_id, receiver_id), goods_id ) latest ON LEAST(cm.sender_id, cm.receiver_id) = latest.user_a AND GREATEST(cm.sender_id, cm.receiver_id) = latest.user_b AND cm.goods_id = latest.goods_id AND cm.create_time = latest.max_time LEFT JOIN `user` u ON u.id = CASE WHEN cm.sender_id = #{userId} THEN cm.receiver_id ELSE cm.sender_id END LEFT JOIN goods g ON g.id = cm.goods_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT sender_id, goods_id, COUNT(*) AS unread_count FROM chat_message WHERE receiver_id = #{userId} AND is_read = 0 GROUP BY sender_id, goods_id ) un ON un.sender_id = CASE WHEN cm.sender_id = #{userId} THEN cm.receiver_id ELSE cm.sender_id END AND un.goods_id = cm.goods_id ORDER BY cm.create_time DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM chat_message WHERE receiver_id = #{userId} AND is_read = 0
